title: Second voice download: 'you have everything you need'

tellings.quote: The second one I got which was time uh the download was you are you have everything you need

plain: A man named Brent Friedman says he received a second 'download,' a message that came to him unbidden, telling him 'you have everything you need.' Friedman tells Michels this as his own experience, the second of such messages he says he got.
